name: Durability Watch
summary: Keeps an eye on how worn your equipped gear is and warns you in time, before an item breaks in the middle of a fight.
logoPrompt: A steel knight's helmet with a small crack and a few scratches, a glowing round gauge with a needle pointing to the red zone set in front of its lower edge
description: **Durability Watch shows the condition of your gear in percent and warns you before anything breaks, so you never find out at the worst moment.**
## Features
- A small display with your overall gear condition and the most worn item, in green, yellow or red.
- Mouse over it to see every damaged item with its slot.
- One warning on screen and in chat when an item drops to your warning level. The next one comes after a repair.
- At a vendor that can repair, one chat line tells you what a full repair costs.
## How to use
It starts on its own. Drag the display where you like it and type `/dw` (or `/durabilitywatch`) to see the state and all commands.
## In detail
### Gear durability in percent

The first line, "Gear 87%", is the durability of everything you wear added together. The second line names the most worn item, for example "Feet 34%". Values are rounded down, so 100% means not worn at all. Green is above 50%, yellow 50% or less, red 20% or less. It updates whenever durability changes or you swap gear.
### The damaged item list
Mouse over the display to list every damaged item, most worn first, with its slot, item link and percent, plus your warning level.
### The low durability warning

When your most worn item drops to the warning level (25% by default), a red line appears where the game shows its error messages, and a chat message names the item. You get this warning once. It comes back only once all your gear is above the warning level again, after a repair or a change of gear.
### Repair cost at the vendor
When you open a vendor who can repair and something is damaged, one chat line tells you what repairing all your gear there costs. The addon never repairs by itself and never spends your gold.
### Commands
- `/dw` – shows gear condition, warning level and display state.
- `/dw warn 30` – sets the warning level, a whole number from 5 to 90.
- `/dw lock` – locks or unlocks the display in place.
- `/dw hide` and `/dw show` – hide or show the display.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail only. It reads only the durability of your equipped items, not of items in your bags.
- The warning has no sound.
- The addon is in English.
- It saves only its settings and the display position, shared by all your characters, until you delete the saved data.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
